title: Run result
description: The sealed, top-level record for one engine-runner run: protocol and version fingerprints plus per-stage outcomes. Written to data/results/<run-id>/run.json only after all stages have completed and are validated.

invalidation_reason.description: Required when status is failed or invalidated: for invalidated, e.g. a boundary-validation failure or a contamination report during a reasoning stage; for failed, e.g. a stage exhausting its retry budget.

stage_order.description: The stage order the protocol DECLARED, in run order. Optional because manifests sealed before it was recorded lack it; downstream scoring reads the declaration from here, never infers it from which outputs exist.

agent_config_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each stage's agent config file (the vendor binding: adapter, model, effort, budget). Recorded alongside protocol_hash because the experiment and the vendor binding vary independently, and both determine a run's numbers.

tool_sets.description: The resolved tool grant per stage. Recorded because the tool set determines what a reviewer can discover, and a default applied in code when the arm file omits the key would otherwise be invisible to every hash here.

boundary_waivers.description: Bundle-relative paths this run's protocol waived from the boundary validator's oracle-name heuristic. Recorded alongside the protocol hash because a waiver weakens a contamination check, and an auditor should see it here rather than having to find it in the protocol file.

auth_mode.description: Which kind of credential produced this stage, never the credential itself. The kind changes the invocation, not just the billing: a claude api_key run uses --bare (no hooks, no LSP, no CLAUDE.md discovery), while oauth_token cannot use --bare and runs with the CLI's normal defaults active, so the two are not directly comparable. Values are per-vendor: claude reports api_key or oauth_token, codex api_key or access_token. Optional: adapters with no credential concept (fixture) omit it, and results written before this field existed remain valid run-result/v1.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds summed across every attempt of this stage, including attempts that failed and were retried. Derived here so a reader never has to subtract timestamps.

vendor_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds the vendor CLI reports for its own work, summed across attempts. Absent when the vendor reports no timing. duration_ms minus this is engine overhead: container start, mounting, and the per-attempt snapshot copy.

vendor_api_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds the vendor CLI reports as spent in API calls, summed across attempts. Separates model time from the CLI's own overhead.

usage.description: Summed across every attempt of this stage, failed attempts included, matching duration_ms. A run carrying only this field and no final_attempt_usage predates that change and holds the winning attempt's usage alone.

final_attempt_usage.description: The winning attempt's usage on its own. Per-attempt is the correct denominator for a budget check, since max_cost_usd bounds one invocation rather than a whole stage.
